shots.action: A locked static camera holds on the interior of a night bus, framing a rain-covered side window that fills most of the image, with the dim cabin edge and empty seat backs soft in the foreground. Beyond the glass, city lights smear into wavering streaks of amber and cool white as the bus travels. Water already sheets down the pane; individual droplets gather along the upper glass and begin to merge into a single heavier bead that swells without falling.
shots.what_changes: The scattered droplets along the top of the pane consolidate into one swollen, heavy bead of water that has not yet released.

subjects: out-of-focus night streetlights behind the pane
shots.action: The shot cuts to a closer view of the same rain-streaked glass, now filling the frame with condensation haze and the out-of-focus glow of streetlights behind it. The swollen bead at the top of the pane breaks loose under its own weight and drags a clean, wavering channel down through the fogged surface, clearing a thin line of sharp night outside as it descends past the center of the frame, while smaller droplets cling motionless around its path.
shots.what_changes: A single rivulet releases from the top of the glass and carves a clean descending channel through the condensation, revealing a thin line of sharp night beyond the fogged surface.

description.text: Rain covers the side window of a night bus, filling most of the frame with beads, streaks and soft reflections. Beyond the glass, city lights smear into long amber and cool-white trails across the dark as the bus moves. The dim cabin edge and the rounded backs of empty seats sit soft and dark in the foreground. Along the upper pane, scattered droplets tremble in the passing glow, then several smaller beads slide together and swell into one heavy pendant of water. Finer drops cling around it, each holding a tiny point of light, while the rest of the glass stays blurred and dense with rain. The outer world remains only color and motion, while the interior stays still and almost black at the edges.
A rain-covered bus window holds a static composition, with city lights smeared beyond the glass and empty seat backs soft in the foreground.
Droplets along the upper pane merge into a single heavy bead that swells without falling.
The heavy bead trembles in the reflected glow while finer drops cling around it.
The camera holds a static shot.

A closer view fills the frame with fogged, rain-streaked glass. Condensation turns the night beyond into soft halos, with out-of-focus streetlights glowing behind the pane. The swollen bead at the top releases and drags a clean, wavering channel downward through the mist. As it descends past the center, the cleared line reveals a narrow, sharp strip of street outside, bright against the fogged surface. Smaller droplets around the track remain fixed, and new beads gather along the upper edge, catching faint reflections. The fogged surface diffuses every detail into pale circles; the water channel is the only crisp line. The channel widens slightly near its lower end before the water continues to slide from view.
The closer view shows fogged glass, condensation haze, and out-of-focus streetlights behind the pane.
The released bead drags a clean channel down through the condensation, opening a thin line of sharp night outside.
Small droplets stay fixed around the descending track as new beads gather along the top edge.
The camera holds a static shot.
